{{Quote|Hmm...nothing in the archives that sheds much more light on the kidnapping, but I'm certain I knew who the last two kidnappers were. You'll have to find my notes on the crime. They would be in an old warehouse in Narmle where much of my old belongings are stored.|[[Horace Korr]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:V" />}}
A '''warehouse''' in [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] was in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the old warehouse belonged to [[Horace Korr]], a retired ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]].<ref name="SWG:V" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Korr accepted to help [[Wernell Covington]] in finding the kidnappers and murderers of his daughter [[Felicia]]. In the meantime, the warehouse had been occupied by a group of thugs. To gather evidence on the identities of two kidnappers, Horace Korr tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with fighting the thugs and recovering the [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] he left behind in the lower level of the warehouse. Horace Korr eventually discovered that the two escaped murderers were [[Jurgen Nath]] and [[Vladlun Travan]].<ref name="SWG:V" />

==Behind the scenes==
The warehouse in Narmle was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:V" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The warehouse was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
